brief: A rack on the ceiling above my bed to hang my road bike from.

requirements.evidence: 4-cell bar (piece:-1,0,0;full through piece:2,0,0;full) with 2 hook plates (accessory:0#0,0#1, accessory:0#1,0#1) giving 4 hooks in a row. Shape suits hanging but holding strength not checked.
requirements.requirement: Rack with hooks to hang a road bike from

requirements.evidence: Build has no verified ceiling fixing and the configurator does not check attachment to a ceiling, joists, or overhead safety. Keyhole/cleat options are side-wall hangers, not a verified ceiling mount.
requirements.requirement: Mounted on the ceiling above a bed

requirements.evidence: A road bike is ~8-12kg overhead above a person. The configurator checks fit/collisions only; it knows nothing about material, strength, load ratings, or printed-part safety overhead. This cannot be verified and must not be trusted overhead without independent engineering.
requirements.requirement: Safely carry a road bike load overhead

finish.summary: Built a 4-cell bar with two hook plates (4 hooks) as a rack shape; check_build is clear. Ceiling mounting and safe overhead support of a road bike are unmet: strength, fixings and overhead safety cannot be verified here — do not hang a bike above a bed from 3D-printed parts without independent structural approval.

lines.label: M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

lines.key: pvc-section-double  (cut 18 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))
lines.label: pvc-section-double (cut 18 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes
